headline: Japan establishes a cross-government council for AI and digital reform
summary: Japan’s Cabinet decided on 2026-10-20 to establish a cross-government AI and Digital Reform Promotion Council. Its remit includes reviewing socioeconomic rules and institutions, AI/digital infrastructure and AX/DX implementation, with the Chief Cabinet Secretary and AI/digital reform minister as chairs. The Digital Agency provides secretariat support, and meeting materials and minutes are generally to be published. The decision establishes a formal coordination body and its stated remit, not subsequent policy changes or implementation outcomes.
